thread:
sara-ng: Quick follow-up on GPU-specific kernel routing — H100 vs A100 vs L4. I sketched a few gating options and wanted opinions before I turn it into code.

miguel-chen: +1. Curious about criteria: SM features (fp8/tensor-core shapes), driver compute capability, and available shared memory?

bobby-w: I'd prefer a capability mask approach rather than hardcoding model->kernel mapping. Keeps us flexible for future GPUs. :thumbsup:

anika: Agree. Also need runtime cost analysis: how expensive is switching kernels mid-request if we detect fallback? That could add latency.

sara-ng: For latency, plan is to pick kernel at request start using cached device profile. Only fallback to reference path on kernel error. No mid-request switch.

thomas-r: What about kernel variants: (1) fused attention w/FP8 on H100, (2) CUTLASS tensor cores FP16/TF32 on A100, (3) compact tiling for L4 to avoid register pressure. We should tag kernels with attributes: [fp8, fused, tile64x64, sm90-only] etc.

miguel-chen: Exactly. Our dispatch logic could be something like: 
```
preferenced = ["fused-fp8","fused-fp16","cutlass-fp16","ref-fp32"]
for k in preferenced:
  if device.supports(k) and model.profile.matches(k):
    select(k)
    break
```
Keep it simple and data driven.

bobby-w: We also need to record why a kernel was chosen for observability (model_id, device_id, kernel_tag, reason). Helps troubleshooting perf regressions.

infra-bot: perf-matrix: h100-80b:fused-fp8=1.0x, a100-80b:cutlass-fp16=0.82x, l4-80b:tiling-compact=0.65x (relative to baseline ref-fp32).

anika: Nice numbers. For L4, the lower perf vs A100 makes me think we should prefer smaller batch sizes + more aggressive KV cache reuse rather than heavy kernel specialization.

thomas-r: Tradeoffs: H100 FP8 path gives big throughput wins but we need stable numeric validation (QA evals on critical prompts). If any output divergence crosses threshold, we should auto-fallback to fp16 path.

sara-ng: Proposal summary: 
- Maintain device capability catalog at startup (sm, driver, supported-instrs, tensor-core-shapes, fp8-runtime).
- Tag kernels with capability predicates and model suitability tags (seq-len, head-dim, quant-support).
- Dispatch at request start using cached device profile + model profile.
- Telemetry: log kernel_choice + reason + perf samples.
- Fallback on kernel error or quality-regression triggers.

miguel-chen: Sounds good. A couple specifics: add a grace period when promoting a new kernel (canary 1% traffic) and profile it. Also ensure we surface counterexamples (prompts that diverge) to evals.

bobby-w: Implementation note: keep gating logic in a small module (no heavy dependency on runtime internals). That way private deployments can override policies.

anika: One last ask: include a debug-mode env var to force kernel selection for repro (e.g., EXPORT KERNEL_FORCE=fused-fp8). Saves a ton of time when debugging production anomalies.

sara-ng: Good. I'll draft a short RFC with the predicate DSL and the telemetry fields. Will include a minimal canary rollout plan and rollback triggers (latency > 2x, quality drop > 1% on eval set).

thomas-r: Thanks — also add a checklist for tests (unit, smoke on all three archs, and an integration perf harness).

sara-ng: Will do. Filing the RFC later today. :rocket:
